name: Star Charter
statusNote: The original game in the line, live and canonical; the repo retains the full combined git history from before star-charter-pro and echo-bat were split out.
oneLiner: A constellation-charting roguelite — pilot a heavy, drifty survey probe, trace each constellation's blueprint on an atlas plate, refit every third plate.
stack: single-file HTML/CSS/JS (~2268 lines), no build step

components.name: Game state machine
components.desc: title, playing, choosing, dying, over, paused — plus the player object and entity arrays.

components.name: Constellation generation
components.desc: genShape(n) wandering-walk algorithm, mapped onto the play field per plate.

components.name: Upgrade system
components.desc: Six refit upgrades (Ion Vanes, Star Anchor, Phase Veil, Stardust Aegis, Chart Lens, Survey Beam) with capped stacks and derived stats.

components.name: Audio
components.desc: Lazy AudioContext with an ambient drone, black-hole rumble, and synth cues — all generated.

components.name: Background / parallax
components.desc: Seeded layers of nebulae, background stars, and meteors.

components.name: Render + loop
components.desc: draw() orchestrates background, charted stars, hazards, probe, particles; classic rAF loop.

dataFlow: Pointer hold-to-thrust (or keyboard) feeds update(dt), which computes a thrust vector toward the pointer with arrive-dampening.
Black-hole gravity and soft-wall forces apply, then velocity integrates with drag.
Camera parallax advances and hazard spawn timers age.
Collision checks resolve shield, dodge, or damage.
Waypoint proximity triggers chartStar() — score, plate completion, and the refit flow.
draw() renders parallax, entities, and the plate-progress mini-canvas.
Audio cues fire with events; rAF reschedules.
integrations: Archive-nav links to star-charter-pro and echo-bat
decisions: Movement is deliberately heavy — slow to build and shed speed — so refits are the taming lever.
Refit offers 1-of-3 every third plate, with a score-only filler when the pool exhausts.
Plate hues cycle a fixed gold-anchored palette.
prefers-reduced-motion disables background meteors and halves particle counts.
The repo intentionally keeps the full git history — where the line was born.
